source_clause: HVACP13.) For vehicles with a lower hvac screen, interactions with that screen will not trigger popups on the head unit (e.g. temperature popup, fan speed popup, mode popup).
reasoning: 驗證目標：14.13（HVACP13）定出配備下 HVAC 螢幕之車輛，於該螢幕上之操作不觸發 head unit 之 popup，單一 leaf。關鍵情境條件：**本節之配置條件為第九軸之另一值** —— 條文明文「For vehicles with **a lower hvac screen**」，故 PC 取其**有**值（出處 14.13），與本批其餘各節之「不補第九軸」形成對照：其餘節之可觀察量為 comfort popup（6.3 之明文例外），而本節之主題正是該螢幕本身。依 **R-C34** 第十三軸補、EMEA 排除補。為什麼這樣切：一句一 leaf。刻意略過：條文以 `e.g.` 舉三種 popup，本條以溫度 popup 為代表（同 14.3）。

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: 下 HVAC 螢幕之操作與 head unit 上之 popup（其不出現）
interface_axis_review.axis_9: **取其另一值** —— 條文明文「For vehicles with a lower hvac screen」，故 PC 為**有**下螢幕（出處 14.13）
interface_axis_review.axis_12: 不暴露 —— 不觀察 tab
interface_axis_review.axis_13: 暴露 → 全數補（3 旋鈕 ICS 車無 HVAC popup，出處 2.14）
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: 補排除；**逐條答見各 TC 之 `emea_ics_review`** —— `ch16_mirror_map.tsv` 之 **ch14 側全無列**（ch16 十八節無 popup 專章），故全批皆為 `no-counterpart` 而 verdict `yes`

tcs.tc_title: Lower HVAC screen interactions raise no head unit pop-up
tcs.test_item: For vehicles with a lower HVAC screen, interactions with that screen shall not trigger popups on the head unit
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle has a lower HVAC screen (14.13)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Change the temperature on the lower HVAC screen
2. Read the head unit for an HVAC pop-up
tcs.expected_result:
1. The lower HVAC screen shows the new temperature
2. No HVAC pop-up is shown on the head unit
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

emea_ics_review.ch16_sentence: ch16 十八節無任何 HVAC popup 之專章（`ch16_mirror_map.tsv` 之 ch14 側全無列）—— 逐條之答為「ch16 無對應句」，故 EMEA ICS 車輛上本條無對象，排除成立
